integrity: The angle-bisector parametrization and discriminant root counts are reconstructed exactly over a real algebraic number field. The packaged computation uses exact symbolic arithmetic and Sturm root counting; no floating-point root count supports the claim.
scientific_limitations: The result refines one explicit QL^2 configuration and does not settle the open maximum-real-count problem. It uses the source's certified total of 14 real QL^2 circles and independently determines the exact branch distribution.
title: An exact 8+6 angle-bisector split for the 14-real QL² configuration
